description: Golden test fixtures for DaLiuRen decoupling migration. Each case exercises a distinct use case path.

fixtures.description: Datetime-based divination: 戊申年 丁巳月 庚午日 丑时 — tests full CalculateDivinationUseCase flow with automatic datetime resolution
Manual divination with explicit JiaZi parameters: 丁巳日 阳遁 巳将 子时 — tests CalculateDivinationUseCase with ManualJuParams
YuDing keti match — dayJiaZi=丁巳, patternName contains a known yuding keti entry. Tests MatchYuDingKetiUseCase with expected match result.
YuDing keti no-match — dayJiaZi and patternName combination that yields zero entries. Tests MatchYuDingKetiUseCase empty-result path.
ShenSha calculation for 甲子年甲寅月甲子日甲子时 — tests CalculateShenShaUseCase. Expected: 太岁 at 子, 干德 at 寅.
Keti data loading and pattern-name matching — tests GetKetiDataUseCase to verify keti lessons load correctly and findByNames works.
